title: Work orders Delete lets the user delete work orders
custom_preconds: 1. A user has a role with Work orders View, Create & Edit and Delete.
custom_steps:
1. Log in and open a non-critical work order.
  2. Click the Delete action.
  3. Confirm.
  4. Return to the list.
custom_expected:
The Delete action is shown.

A confirmation dialog appears.

The deleted work order is gone from the list.
evidence: UI (role with Work Orders Delete): the work order header more_vert menu shows "Delete Work Order" (menu: Audit Log | Add Fee/Discount | Delete Work Order). Deletion action present for the Delete permission. screenshot wo-delete-role.
